MALTASUPPLEMENTAL.title: MALTASUPPLEMENTAL — Malta Trip Guide (Source-Linked)
MALTASUPPLEMENTAL.description: Source-linked Malta trip guide for the traveller-supplied 13–19 October 2026 window, based at a Qawra hotel: eight pages (overview, transport, food and cafés, activities and sights, an everyday guide for a U.S. traveller, sports radio, an expense planner with blank budget rows and local-only autosave, and a sources/status log). Its own README states the event's ticketing listing names the venue, address, 14–18 October dates, doors, age limit and free tickets, and that a full event day has no listed bus return, so it recommends a taxi or ride-hailing return; it also labels itself a dated research and planning aid, not a booking, fare or reception guarantee, and keeps the remaining uncertainties (exact entrance, door-to-door route, radio carriage, winter fare changeover) in an open-questions log with a claim-by-claim source log.
flags: README states the guide is a dated research and planning aid — not a booking, admission, fare, service, radio-reception or programme-carriage guarantee — and that several questions (exact entrance, door-to-door routing, Malta radio carriage of a named match, the 2026/27 winter fare changeover) remain open.
Fares and timetables are quoted as read from the operator's own pages on 2026-10-11 and are date-sensitive; the directory repeats the repository's figures and does not re-check them.
